Notes

Morgaroth, the schemer, is an Archdemon and also a member of the Triangle of Terror.

Morgaroth was first sighted on Arcania on August 07, 2006. It was first killed on Aldora and Titania on September 6, 2006.

When it appears, all players on the world receive 3 messages that are broadcasted exactly 6 minutes apart. Morgaroth spawns when the last message appears, exactly 12 minutes after the first message.

  1. 00:00:00: The ancient volcano on Goroma slowly becomes active once again.
  2. 00:06:00: There is an evil presence at the volcano of Goroma.
  3. 00:12:00: Evil Cultists have called an ancient evil into the volcano on Goroma. Beware of its power mortals.
Morgaroth has been sighted for the first time. Before Summer Update 2007 (old Morgaroth).
Jackwalker dies by a melee hit of 2013 hitpoints. After Summer Update 2007 (new Morgaroth).
Nottinghster dies by an insane combo of 2766. After Winter Update 2007 (new Morgaroth)
New Morgaroth's spell. After 2008 summer update (new Morgaroth).
